name: Professor Dr. Syed Akhter Hossain
faculty: Faculty of Science and Information Technology
department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering
bio: Professor Syed Akhter Hossain joined as the Dean, Faculty of Science and Information Technology and Professor at the Department of Computer Science and Engineering at Daffodil International University, one of the top leading digital university of Bangladesh from 1st July 2023. He received several national and international awards for his outstanding contribution in ICT education, innovative projects for the visually impaired people. His current research interests include Machine Learning and AI with Natural Language Processing.

name: Professor Dr. Mohammed Masum Iqbal
faculty: Faculty of Business and Entrepreneurship
department: Department of Innovation and Entrepreneurship
bio: Dr. Mohammed Masum Iqbal is a distinguished academic with a robust research portfolio in business management. Currently serving as the Dean of the Faculty of Business and Entrepreneurship at Daffodil International University, he has cultivated a rich background in research methodologies, particularly evident from his extensive publications in esteemed journals. His scholarly contributions span a wide array of topics, including customer relationship management, green finance, FinTech in agriculture, and the economic implications of green logistics within the Belt and Road Initiative framework. Notable publications include insights into blockchain technology for social media, and the behavioral dynamics around online buying during the COVID-19 pandemic. Dr. Iqbal's work consistently emphasizes sustainability and technology's role in evolving business landscapes, contributing significantly to academic and practical understanding in these areas.

name: Prof. Dr. Md. Kabirul Islam
faculty: Faculty of Graduate Studies
department: Faculty of Graduate Studies
expertise: Multimedia and Web Technologies in Learning
bio: Prof. Dr. Md Kabirul Islam is a prominent academic and the Dean of the Faculty of Science and Information Technology at Daffodil International University (DIU), where he is a Professor in the Department of Multimedia & Creative Technology. With a PhD in ICT-Supported Teaching and Learning from Victoria University, Australia, and advanced degrees in Physics and Education from leading Bangladeshi institutions, Dr. Islam has developed expertise in ICT for development, sustainable research culture, e-learning, and collaborative learning. His professional contributions include serving on the Research and Innovation Committee of the Association of Universities of Asia and the Pacific (AUAP) and participating in international panels, such as EURAS in Turkey, on global university rankings. Dr. Islam has led impactful initiatives like the Living Value Project at DIU under the Magna Charta Observatory, which fosters academic values and integrity. He is also affiliated with the Association of Commonwealth Universities (ACU) in the UK, where he provides training on grant proposal writing for early-career researchers. Dr. Islam’s leadership and commitment to education and research continue to advance both DIU and the broader academic community.

name: Professor Dr. M. Shamsul Alam
faculty: Faculty of Engineering
department: Department of Civil Engineering
bio: Professor Dr. M. Shamsul Alam is the Dean of the Faculty of Engineering at Daffodil International University (DIU) in Bangladesh. He earned his Ph.D. in Electrical and Electronic Engineering in 1991. His extensive experience and contributions have significantly advanced the field of electrical and electronic engineering in Bangladesh.

name: Professor Dr. Md. Bellal Hossain
faculty: Faculty of Health and Life Sciences
department: Department of Public Health
bio: Professor Dr. Md. Bellal Hossain, a distinguished academic at Daffodil International University (DIU), serves as the Dean (In-Charge) and Professor in the Department of Public Health within the Faculty of Health and Life Sciences. With a Ph.D. in Applied Chemistry and Chemical Technology from the University of Dhaka, his expertise spans food processing, safety, and nutrition. Dr. Hossain has led numerous national and international research initiatives, particularly focusing on improving public health through nutrition and food safety.

name: Professor Dr. Liza Sharmin
faculty: Faculty of Humanities and Social Sciences
department: Department of English
bio: Professor Dr. Liza Sharmin is the Dean of the Faculty of Humanities and Social Sciences at Daffodil International University. She has completed both her B A (Hons.) and M A in English Language and Literature from Jahangirnagar University, Bangladesh. She is one of the handful of scholars who earned their PhD in the field of ESP in Bangladesh. She is an experienced and dedicated teacher of English Literature, ELT, ESP, and Linguistics.  She has published widely on ESP, Education, ELT, and Literature in books and renowned national and international journals. She has 35 significant publications which cover articles in national and international journals, book chapters, edited books, translations, and conference proceedings. Her latest book Voice Assistants: Future of Interaction was published in the year 2022.

name: Dr. Md. Kamrul Hossain
faculty: Faculty of Science and Information Technology
department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering
bio: Dr. Md. Kamrul Hossain is an Associate Professor at the Department of Computer Science and Engineering and the Additional Director at the Division of Research (DoR) at Daffodil International University (DIU). He is part of the Faculty of Science and Information Technology and specializes in areas like efficiency measurement (DEA and SFA), the impact of climate change, applications of statistical distributions, and statistical data mining. Dr. Hossain contributes significantly to academic research and development at DIU, with a focus on data-driven and statistically grounded approaches.

name: Mohammed Sazzad Yousuf Sourab
faculty: Faculty of Engineering
department: Department of Information and Communication Engineering
bio: I am an Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering (ETE) graduate from Chittagong University of Engineering and Technology (CUET) and also pursuing MSc Engineering from the same department. I’m currently working as a Lecturer at the Department of Information and Communication Engineering (ICE) at Daffodil International University (DIU). My research fields are Computer vision, Machine Learning, and Artificial Intelligence. I have done my undergraduate thesis on Disease diagnosis using Hybrid models combining ML & DL. I’ve sound knowledge of programming languages like Python, R, and MATLAB.

name: Ms. Farjana Akter Boby
faculty: Faculty of Health and Life Sciences
department: Department of Physical Education and Sports Science
bio: I'm a dedicated researcher specializing in Physical Education and Sports Science. With a profound expertise in Sports Science, Exercise Science, and Sports Injuries, I delve into areas such as Exercise Performance, Sport Biomechanics, and Strength & Conditioning. Armed with a keen interest in enhancing athletic performance and preventing injuries, My research endeavors focus on topics ranging from Exercise Physiology to Injury Prevention. My notable publications include comparative analyses of motor fitness components in women's cricket teams, studies on aerobic endurance in elite female cricket players, and investigations into the relationship between motor fitness and sports performance. Through my work, I contribute significantly to the understanding of physical fitness and performance enhancement strategies in sports. I actively disseminate my findings through reputable journals and platforms like ResearchGate, fostering collaboration and knowledge exchange within the scientific community. My ResearchGate Link: https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Farjana-Boby-3/research

name: Mohammad Mustafizur Rahman
faculty: Faculty of Humanities and Social Sciences
department: Department of English
bio: I am a research enthusiast who wants to contribute to the overall development of the socio-cultural arena from a global perspective.

name: Professor Dr. Kudrat-E-Khuda Babu
faculty: Faculty of Humanities and Social Sciences
department: Department of Development Studies
bio: Dr. Kudrat-E-Khuda (Babu) is a Professor of Law; Associate Dean and Research Coordinator at the Faculty of Humanities and Social Sciences at Daffodil International University. He is also a Visiting Professor at both the Lyceum of the Philippines University (Philippines) and Chandigarh University (India); and a Research Fellow at the Metharath (Shinawatra) University, Thailand. Dr. Babu is a Subject and discipline Expert at the Bangladesh Accreditation Council and also a Country Expert for Bangladesh under the “Digital Society Project” by the North Dakota State University, the USA. He published more than 75 research articles, books, book chapters, and book reviews in Bangladesh and abroad, including in the Scopus Indexed & Web of Science indexed journals along with the journals of Oxford University, Cambridge University, and McGill University. Dr. Babu is a PhD Thesis Reviewer for various universities at home and abroad and is a member of the editorial board of nine peer-reviewed, and Scopus-indexed journals from India, Canada, Saudi Arabia, Turkey, the UK, and the USA. He participated in and presented research papers in Singapore, Philippines, Taiwan, Thailand, Nepal, Malaysia, India, Turkey, Germany, and so on. He is also a Fellow at the International Academy for Leadership, Germany and a former Associate Member at Centre for the Study of Global Human Movement, University of Cambridge (UK).

name: Dr. Mohammad Reyad Hossain
faculty: Faculty of Business and Entrepreneurship
department: Department of Innovation and Entrepreneurship
expertise: Static and Dynamic Panel Data analysis
bio: Dr. Mohammad Reyad Hossain holds a Ph.D. in finance from the School of Business & Economics at Universiti Putra Malaysia, where he demonstrated excellent academic achievements and earned his Ph.D. with a Graduate on Time distinction. He has published several papers in Scopus and Web of Science-indexed journals. His research interests include corporate finance, financial markets and instruments, and financial economics. Prior to pursuing his Ph.D., he gained professional experience at various multinational corporations. Dr. Reyad is an ad hoc reviewer for various accounting and finance journals and has participated in international seminars and research workshops. He possesses expertise in quantitative research and Panel Data analysis and is a trainer and facilitator in quantitative research methodologies.

name: Ms. Rozina Akter
faculty: Faculty of Business and Entrepreneurship
department: Department of Business Administration
bio: Ms.Rozina Akter is an Assistant Professor in Banking at the Department Of Business Administration in the Faculty Of Business and Entrepreneurship of Daffodil International University.  She received her BBA and MBA degree from University of Dhaka.At present she is persuing her PhD in University of Dhaka. She has 14 publications in quality journals and she presented papers in 8 conference in national and international level. She received inspiring women award in 2020 from Thailand and she received several awards from Daffodil International University for her scholarly publications.Her research areas of interest include Finance, Banking and Insurance.

name: Mr. Md. Shoaib Arifin
faculty: Faculty of Health and Life Sciences
department: Department of Agricultural Science
bio: I am Md. Shoaib Arifin, a dedicated researcher specializing in agricultural chemistry. My passion lies in advancing the field through innovative solutions to pressing challenges. As a lecturer at Daffodil International University, Bangladesh, I focus on topics such as soil fertility management, crop nutrition, and soil salinity. Through my research, I aim to enhance sustainable agricultural practices, thereby contributing to food security and livelihood improvement in Bangladesh. My commitment is reflected in my numerous publications, presentations, and active engagement within academic and professional circles

name: Dr. Md Zahid Hasan
faculty: Faculty of Science and Information Technology
department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering
bio: Md. Zahid Hasan is currently an Associate Professor in the Department of Computer Science and Engineering at Daffodil International University. He holds a Ph.D. in Computer Science and Engineering, and his Ph.D. research was on analyzing the performance of the Decision support system under both risk and uncertainty. Dr Zahid has been constantly producing high-quality research and scholarly works in both national and international journals and conferences. He is very active in conducting multidisciplinary research. His research expertise includes machine learning, artificial intelligence, deep learning, Bio-Informatics, image analysis, and decision theory. He is the director of the Health Informatics Research Lab (HIRL) in the department of CSE. He has published over 60 articles in high-ranking journals and conferences. He has obtained grant funding from Charles Darwin University, Australia.

name: Tajim Md. Niamat Ullah Akhund
faculty: Faculty of Science and Information Technology
department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering
bio: Tajim Md. Niamat Ullah Akhund is currently pursuing a Ph.D. with the MEXT scholarship(Japanese Government Highest Scholarship) from Saga University, Japan. He is a lecturer in the Department of CSE, at Daffodil International University. He got the prestigious ICT Fellowship 2019 from the Govt. of Bangladesh. He completed his M.Sc. in 2019 and B.Sc. 2018 in Information Technology from Jahangirnagar University, Bangladesh. He has been an IEEE member for seven years and chairperson of IEEE SB, JU. His research interests are IoT, Robotics, and Embedded Systems. He has a good number of projects and publications in these research fields.

name: Md. Yousuf Ali
faculty: Faculty of Science and Information Technology
department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering
bio: I am MD. YOUSUF ALI, an individual who has successfully obtained a Bachelor of Science in Mathematics and a Master of Science in Applied Mathematics from Khulna University, Bangladesh. Presently, I serve as a Mathematics lecturer in the Department of CSE at Daffodil International University. My key area of research specialization lies within the captivating domain of fluid dynamics, in which I ardently explore the multifaceted behaviors exhibited by distinct fluidic phenomena.

name: Mr. Dewan Golam Yazdani
faculty: Faculty of Business and Entrepreneurship
department: Department of Business Administration
bio: Dewan Golam Yazdani Showrav is an Assistant Professor of Marketing with vast experience in research in various marketing disciplines, including consumer behavior, digital marketing, and brand management. The researcher has nine publications in total, including three in SCOPUS-indexed journals. The researcher has received three research awards from Daffodil International University for publication in high-indexed journals. Currently, the researcher is doing a PhD in digital marketing.

name: Md Sanowar Hosen
faculty: Faculty of Engineering
department: Department of Electrical and Electronic Engineering
bio: I am Md. Sanowar Hosen, specializing in biosensors and Photonic Crystal Fibers (PCF). My research focuses on developing advanced biosensing platforms for medical diagnostics and environmental monitoring, as well as exploring the optical properties of PCF for applications in telecommunications.

name: Dr. Nurul Mohammad Zayed
faculty: Faculty of Business and Entrepreneurship
department: Department of Business Administration
bio: Dr. Nurul Mohammad Zayed is an Associate Professor of Department of Business Administration at Daffodil International University, Dhaka, Bangladesh. He has a PhD in Management (Area: International Business/Finance/Economics) from Techno India University, India. He teaches Economics & Finance. He has been teaching for more than 13 years. He is doing research for more than 13 years and has a strong knack for research.  He has more than 147 research publications (referred journal articles), 5 books & 6 editorials in several reputed national and international peer reviewed journals. He is the member of Editorial Boards of several International Journals and Conferences. He presented research papers in more than 20 national and international conferences. He presented and participated in more than 40 national and international seminars. He facilitated, coordinated and participated in more than 54 national and international workshops/trainings. He visited more than 10 domestic industries as a part of industry visit. He got several awards including teaching excellence awards from India, best paper awards(twice) in the conferences, best research award, DIU (2020 & 2022), certificate of appreciation for paper presentation and reviewing papers. He also got Mevlana Scholarship from Turkish Higher Council at Bulent Ecevit University, Turkey.  His research interest is in Economics & Finance. He got Full Bright Turkish Government Scholarship (Burslari) for PhD in International Economics at Marmara University, Istanbul, Turkey.

name: Dr. Md. Mahbubul Haque
faculty: Faculty of Engineering
department: Department of Textile Engineering
expertise: Woven fabric production for the export-oriented RMG sector
bio: A Commonwealth Scholar studied M.Sc. and Ph.D. in the field of textiles at the University of Manchester, UK. I have over 33 years of experience in the textile industry, education, research, and innovation. Has been awarded Best Professor of Textile Engineering in Bangladesh in 2019. It was jointly extended by the World Education Congress, CMO Asia, and the CMO Council. I worked as Head of the Dept. (HoD) of Textile Engineering, Daffodil International University (DIU) for 11 years (2009–2019), and the degree of B.Sc. in Textile Engineering at DIU was accredited by the Institution of Engineers Bangladesh (IEB) in 2018. For any textile engineering program, such accreditation was the first in Bangladesh. As HoD, lead a project on educational quality assurance entitled Self Assessment Survey,  funded by the World Bank and executed by the University Grants Commission (UGC) of Bangladesh. An external peer review team led by a renowned international academic rated the work as very good. Played a key role in introducing the M.Sc. in Textile Engineering at the Daffodil International University in 2009 for the first time in Bangladesh. Introduced a new concept of conducting textile engineering lab classes (spinning, weaving, knitting, and textile testing). According to the concept, individual participation in the lab class has been maximized. The concept was widely published in the professional as well as general news media in Bangladesh. For this, I was awarded the Outstanding Professor award by the International Education Summit & Award 2020 held in Bangkok, Thailand, on February 22, 2020. I worked extensively on curriculum development and introduced technical textiles and denim to the curriculum of the B.Sc. in Textile Engineering at Ahsanullah University of Science and Technology (AUST) for the first time in Bangladesh in 2004. Developed original text materials for the production of woven labels. Customized the course content of “Economics for Textile Engineers from general economics to textile economics (in Bangladesh). Professional Association * Chartered member of the International Textile Institute, Manchester, UK. *Life Fellow of The Institution of Engineers Bangladesh (IEB). *Was co-opted as a Council Member of the Mechanical Engineering Division of IEB for the 2011–12 session. *Elected as a council member of the IEB, Dhaka Centre received the highest number of votes in 2013. *Life Member of the Institution of Textile Engineers and Technologists (ITET)

name: Mr. Roni Islam
faculty: Faculty of Science and Information Technology
department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering
bio: I am a new researcher for nanotechnology in physics.  My first paper published at recently in RSC Advanced journal. It is Q1 journal area. It has different synthesis in NPs ( nanoparticles). This paper had to seven coauthors and I had first author.  This paper working in M.Sc. in Rajshahi University.

name: Dr. Srimanti Roy Choudhury
faculty: Faculty of Engineering
department: Department of Electrical and Electronic Engineering
bio: Dr. Srimanti Roychoudhury is working as an Associate Professor of Daffodil International University, Dhaka, Bangladesh. She is an academician, author, and researcher in the areas of Electrical Engineering, with specialized focus on control systems, signals and systems, and allied areas. She has nearly 15 years of experience in teaching and research. Out of which 6 years is after completing her Ph.D. (Tech.) degree. She has completed her B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering from Jalpaiguri Government Engineering College, M. Tech. in Electrical Engineering (with GATE Scholarship from MHRD, Government of India) from the University of Calcutta, and Ph.D. (Tech.) from the same prestigious University (the University of Calcutta). She has published 14 research articles in different national and international journals and conferences, and a few articles are in process. Her first research level book titled 'Analysis and Identification of Time-Invariant Systems, Time-Varying Systems, and Multi-Delay Systems using Orthogonal Hybrid Functions: Theory and Algorithm with MATLAB' published by Springer, Switzerland in 2016. Then the second research level book she published from CRC Press, USA, is titled 'Control System Analysis and Identification with MATLAB: Block Pulse and Related Orthogonal Functions', in 2018.

name: Dr. Sayed Farrukh Ahmed
faculty: Faculty of Business and Entrepreneurship
department: Department of Business Administration
bio: Dr. Sayed Farrukh Ahmed is presently serving as an Associate Professor at the Department of Business Administration, Daffodil International University. He joined the university as an Assistant Professor on January 1, 2013. Before that, he had worked for more than 5 years in different faculty positions at United International University. He was awarded PhD degree from Jahangirnagar University in 2022. He completed his MA International Business from London Metropolitan University, London, UK (2005/6) with the ‘Merit’ Award by obtaining 65.44 marks on average. He also completed Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) from the Department of Accounting & Information Systems (AIS), Faculty of Business Studies, University of Dhaka, Bangladesh, with a CGPA of 3.99 on a 4-point scale in the year 2004.

name: Mr. Ahad Ullah
faculty: Faculty of Engineering
department: Department of Civil Engineering
bio: I have been serving as a senior lecturer at Daffodil International University since 2019. I completed my undergraduate studies at Shahjalal University of Science and Technology and am currently pursuing my M.Sc. from Bangladesh University of Engineering and Technology. My research interests in geotechnical engineering revolve around investigating soil mechanics to aid civil engineering endeavors, with a focus on stabilized soil behavior and soil improvement techniques. Specifically, my work delves into the behavior of reinforced earth, concreted soil, and foundation design. By integrating theoretical research with practical experimentation, I aim to develop sustainable infrastructure solutions that tackle challenges such as urbanization and natural disasters. Through speaking engagements at international conferences, collaboration with diverse teams, and publication in esteemed journals, I endeavor to promote safer and more effective infrastructure globally.

name: Md. Jarif Mahbub
faculty: Faculty of Health and Life Sciences
department: Department of Nutrition and Food Engineering
bio: Md. Jarif Mahbub earned his MS and BS degree in Nutrition and Food Science from the Institute of Nutrition and Food Science (INFS), University of Dhaka (DU) and is currently employed as a Lecturer at the Department of Nutrition and Food Engineering, Daffodil International University. He has spent the last few years working on evaluating various nutrition promoting projects encompassing ready-made garment workers and fresh market vendors. He specializes in data processing, statistical analysis, interpretation, and developing research proposals. His research interests include nutrition and hygiene knowledge, attitude, practice, and behavior (KAPB), diet quality, food security, nutritional status, and climate change.

name: Dr. Imran Mahmud
faculty: Faculty of Science and Information Technology
department: Department of Software Engineering
bio: Dr. Imran Mahmud serves as the Head and Professor at the Department of Software Engineering, Daffodil International University, Bangladesh. He enriches his expertise through roles as a visiting professor at the Graduate School of Business, Universiti Sains Malaysia, and a visiting researcher at Thuongmai University, Vietnam. Dr. Mahmud's academic journey includes a PhD in Technology Management from Universiti Sains Malaysia (2017) and a Master’s in Software Engineering from the University of Hertfordshire, UK (2008). His career has seen significant milestones, such as being a senior lecturer at Universiti Sains Malaysia, and visiting lecturer roles in Indonesia and Hong Kong. Dr. Mahmud's contributions to academia and research are recognized by several prestigious awards, including the “Hall of Fame” and “Prestigious Publication Award” from Universiti Sains Malaysia, along with honors from Thailand and India for his work as a young researcher and scientist.

name: Akibul Islam Chowdhury
faculty: Faculty of Health and Life Sciences
department: Department of Nutrition and Food Engineering
bio: Akibul Islam Chowdhury is a researcher known for his contributions in Nutrition and Food science research. He received his Bachelor's and Master's degree from Noakhali Science and Technology University and obtained 1st class 1st position in the department of Food Technology and Nutrition Science. Since he has been actively engaged in many relevant field of his study such as food science, heavy metal in food, public health nutrition, maternal and child health nutrition etc. Chowdhury's work often focuses on questionnaire development and validation and social knowledge of students. Throughout his career, Chowdhury has published numerous articles in reputable academic journals. He has demonstrated a keen interest in disease management through nutrition, heavy metals and food microbiology along with public health nutrition. His dedication to advancing knowledge in public health nutrition has earned him recognition and respect among his peers. In addition to his research endeavors, Chowdhury is also involved in many activities such as teaching, mentorship, or community engagement.

name: Jawad Hossain
faculty: Faculty of Science and Information Technology
department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering
bio: I've been a lecturer in computer science and engineering (CSE), with a focus on natural language processing (NLP), deep learning, and machine learning. I concentrate on projects involving sentiment analysis, text categorization, and language generation because I have a strong foundation in these areas. I am also skilled in using state-of-the-art frameworks like PyTorch and TensorFlow to create innovative approaches. I have a strong grasp of statistics and analytical abilities, which allow me to create ML and NLP strategies that go beyond what is currently understood. Whether it's developing new algorithms or improving current processes, my aim is to teach students theoretical ideas as well as real-world applications.

name: Abdus Sattar
faculty: Faculty of Science and Information Technology
department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering
bio: Abdus Sattar was born in Comilla, Bangladesh, 1983. He is continuing his Ph.D. degree at the Faculty of Center for Higher Studies and Research (CHSR) in Bangladesh University Professionals (BUP). He obtained his MSc. degree in Computer Science and Engineering (Major in Human-Computer Interaction) in 2012 from KTH-Royal Institute of Technology, Stockholm, Sweden, and BSc. in Computer Science from Ahsanullah University of Science and Technology(AUST) in 2008. Now he is an Assistant Professor & Coordinator of MSc. Program at the Department of Computer Science and Engineering and working as Director of DIU NLP & ML Research Lab at Daffodil International University. He has sixty one (61) publications in International Journals and Conference proceedings. He has worked as a reviewer for a number of international journals and conferences. His main research interests are Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Computer Vision, IoT, and HCI.

name: Jannatul Ferdousi
faculty: Faculty of Health and Life Sciences
department: Department of Nutrition and Food Engineering
bio: I have a experience in working in a research project during my BSc, it was my first attempt as a researcher. Then I did my Masters thesis on Lifestyle Modification and Dietary behavior.

name: Dr. Md. Rezwanul Ahsan
faculty: Faculty of Engineering
department: Department of Electrical and Electronic Engineering
bio: Md. Rezwanul Ahsan is an Associate Professor at the Department of Electrical & Electronic Engineering, Daffodil International University, Dhaka, Bangladesh. He completed M. Sc. in Engineering (Electronics) degree from the Faculty of Engineering, International Islamic University Malaysia (IIUM), mainly focusing on Artificial Neural Network and Biomedical Signal Processing-based research. He awarded Doctoral degree in Electrical, Electronics and Systems Engineering from the Universiti Kebangsaan Malaysia (UKM). His research interests include Communication Antenna Design, Satellite Antennas, and Electromagnetic Radiation Analysis. He worked as Research Associate in several research projects funded by government and non-government organization during master’s and doctoral studies. He has authored and co-authored several book chapters and more than 50 scientific articles in peer reviewed international journals/ conference proceedings. He is a member of Applied Computational Electromagnetic Society (ACES), Institution of Engineers Bangladesh (IEB), and Bangladesh Computer Society (BCS), Internet Society Chapter (ISOC) and International Association of Engineers (IAENG).

name: Md. Saiful Hoque
faculty: Faculty of Engineering
department: Department of Textile Engineering
bio: The area of Mr. Hoque's research corresponds to current issues encountered with protective clothing against heat and flame, which include materials aging, lack of comfort, and protection against toxic combustion gases. For instance, intense heat and other severe conditions sustained by protective clothing against heat and flame in service cause a premature aging of the high-performance fibres; what makes it even more worrisome is that there are sometimes no visible clues before the loss in performance has reached a dangerous level. In addition, Mr. Hoque's research area also includes, development of new materials with extended durability that also ensures environmental sustainability.

name: Rashidul Hasan Hridoy
faculty: Faculty of Science and Information Technology
department: Department of Software Engineering
bio: Rashidul Hasan Hridoy is an adept researcher specializing in machine learning and deep learning applications across diverse domains. With three years of experience in artificial intelligence research and data science, Hridoy has made significant contributions to the field. His expertise encompasses machine learning, deep learning, computer vision, biomedical engineering, natural language processing, and the Internet of Things. Rashidul Hasan Hridoy has authored numerous impactful journal articles and book chapters, focusing on areas such as disease diagnosis, plant recognition, and food analysis using advanced computational techniques. He has presented his work at esteemed international conferences, demonstrating his prowess in applying deep learning models to solve real-world problems. With a growing citation count and an h-index of 6, Rashidul Hasan Hridoy is committed to advancing the field of artificial intelligence and driving innovation in practical applications.

name: Dr. Syed Ali Fazal
faculty: Faculty of Business and Entrepreneurship
department: Department of Business Administration
bio: Dr. Syed Ali Fazal is an Associate Professor at the Department of Business Administration, Faculty of Business & Entrepreneurship, Daffodil International University Bangladesh. Dr. Fazal served as a Postdoctoral Researcher at UKM-Graduate School of Business (AACSB Accredited), Universiti Kembangan Malaysia (QS World Ranking-159). Dr. Fazal earned his PhD (Management) from the Faculty of Entrepreneurship and Business, University Malaysia Kelantan (No. 1 Entrepreneurial University of Malaysia). He authored more than 50 Academic Journal Articles, a few Conference papers, and a Research Book and managed to secure national and international academic grants as well. His publications are cited more than 1800 times with an H Index 20 (Google Scholar). His research interests revolve around Quantitative Social Science, Knowledge Transfer and Business Management, particularly focusing on Organizational Sustainability and Sustainable Development.

name: Dr. Md. Shahin Azad
faculty: Faculty of Engineering
department: Department of Electrical and Electronic Engineering
bio: This is Dr. Md. Shahin Azad. I have completed B. Sc (hon’s), and M. Sc in Chemistry.  I have also completed M. Phil in Organic Chemistry from BUET. Recently I have successfully completed a Ph.D degree in Chemistry from Universiti Sains Islam Malaysia (USIM). Already I have successfully participated as a presenter in four International Conferences. I have published four research articles in different International Journal with Scopus Index. I have one year experience as a ‘Teaching Assistant’ in the department of Chemistry at BUET where I conducted Chemistry lab courses. I have also experienced as a Lecturer (part-time) in Chemistry (Fall,2017) in the EEE department.  I have also experienced about 10 years’ as a Lab Instructor or Technical officer, Sr. Technical officer and Assistant Director in the Chemistry lab under Faculty of Engineering at DIU. I have expertise in hetero cyclic organic compound synthesis and purification of wastewater by using activated carbon produced from natural by-products such as Rice husk, Coconut coir, Corn cobs, Neem husk and Moringa oleifera etc.

name: Mardia Mumtaz
faculty: Faculty of Engineering
department: Department of Civil Engineering
bio: As a dedicated researcher, I bring over a decade of expertise in civil engineering to my role. Currently serving as a Lecturer at Daffodil International University in Dhaka, BD since August 2017, I am deeply engaged in shaping the next generation of engineers. My teaching portfolio spans structural analysis, building construction, geotechnical engineering, transportation engineering, and water resources engineering. Alongside teaching, I actively contribute to research endeavors, collaborating with colleagues to enhance curricula and courses. Prior to academia, I honed my skills as a Structural Design Consultant at Megacity Builders from March 2015 to December 2019, where I meticulously crafted structural designs, conducted feasibility studies, and ensured compliance with industry standards. My experience also includes a stint as a Structural and Seismic Fitness Auditor at MSD Global Compliance, where I conducted audits, site inspections, and provided invaluable insights to enhance structural safety. Passionate about advancing engineering knowledge, I strive to bridge theory with practice in all facets of my work.

name: Md. Fouad Hossain Sarker
faculty: Faculty of Humanities and Social Sciences
department: Department of Development Studies
bio: I am an Associate Professor of Development Studies in the Faculty of Humanities and Social Sciences at Daffodil International University (DIU) in Bangladesh. My research focuses on e-learning, e-governance, increasing e-service accessibility, and SMART Bangladesh. In addition, I explore migration governance and climate change's consequences for long-term sustainability. My research accolades include fourteen articles indexed in Scopus, eight peer-reviewed non-Scopus publications, a book chapter, and three conference papers. I have supervised over 45 Master's theses at DIU and worked on four projects as a Core Team Member and CO-LEAD RESEARCHER. Moreover, I am an editorial board member for the Journal of Development and Governance and the Sankalp Journal of Multidisciplinary Studies (SJMS). I work as a reviewer for various local and international peer-reviewed journals, such as Journal of Applied Research in Higher Education (Emerald), International Journal of Community Well-Being (Springer), International Journal of Educational Research Open (Elsevier), Heliyon (Elsevier), Computers in Human Behavior Reports (Elsevier), Cogent Social Sciences (Taylor & Francis), International Journal of Human-Computer Interaction (Taylor & Francis), Qeios, International Journal of Emerging Technologies in Learning (iJET), and DIU Journal of Humanities and Social Science in Dhaka, Bangladesh.

name: Dr.Tama Fouzder
faculty: Faculty of Engineering
department: Department of Electrical and Electronic Engineering

bio: Md. Aynul Hasan Nahid is currently working as a lecturer at Daffodil International University. His expertise primarily revolves around the fields of Natural Language Processing, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Digital Image Processing, and Computer Vision. He has a number of publications in SCOPUS-indexed national and international conferences. His dedication to advancing technology through research exemplifies his commitment to the development of innovative solutions in the realm of computational intelligence.

name: Mr. Deawan Rakin Ahamed Remal
faculty: Faculty of Science and Information Technology
department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering
bio: I'm Deawan Rakin Ahamed Remal, a passionate researcher specializing in machine learning, health informatics, computer vision, and natural language processing (NLP). My focus is on leveraging technology for societal betterment, particularly in advancing healthcare solutions through data-driven approaches. In machine learning, I innovate algorithms for predictive modeling and anomaly detection, while in computer vision, I work on image recognition and object detection to enhance visual understanding. Delving into NLP, I contribute to sentiment analysis and text summarization, aiding in the development of intelligent language processing systems. Through collaborative efforts and a relentless drive for innovation, I strive to push the boundaries of knowledge in these fields. Ultimately, my aim is to develop impactful solutions that address real-world challenges and improve the quality of life for individuals globally.

name: Mr. Md. Juwel Rana
faculty: Faculty of Health and Life Sciences
department: Department of Nutrition and Food Engineering
bio: Juwel Rana is a dynamic researcher at the intersection of food technology, postharvest physiology, bioactive compound analysis, and waste management. Armed with a masters in Food Engineering from Bangladesh Agricultural University (BAU), and his career is driven by a passion for enhancing food quality, safety, and sustainability throughout the supply chain. His expertise lies in developing innovative technologies to extend the shelf life of perishable foods, minimizing postharvest losses, and maximizing nutritional value. Mr Rana's research also delves into the analysis of bioactive compounds in foods, exploring their potential health benefits and applications in functional food development. A staunch advocate for sustainability, Mr. Rana is actively involved in projects aimed at reducing food waste and optimizing resource utilization. His work encompasses the development of eco-friendly packaging materials, valorization of food by-products, and implementation of efficient waste management strategies within the food industry. With a strong publication record in leading scientific journals and a track record of securing research grants, Mr. Rana is recognized for his contributions to advancing knowledge in food science and technology. He is also committed to fostering collaboration and knowledge exchange across interdisciplinary fields, recognizing the importance of holistic approaches in addressing complex food-related challenges. Driven by a vision of a healthier, more sustainable food system, Mr. Rana continues to push the boundaries of scientific inquiry, seeking innovative solutions to feed the growing global population while minimizing environmental impact.

name: Ms. Tanzina Afroz Rimi
faculty: Faculty of Science and Information Technology
department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering
bio: I'm Tanzina Afroz Rimi, a passionate researcher in the field of artificial intelligence and machine learning, particularly focusing on medical image analysis and disease detection. With a solid background in computer science and a keen interest in healthcare technology, I've dedicated my efforts to developing innovative solutions to address real-world challenges in medical diagnostics. My journey began with the publication of Derm-NN: Skin Diseases Detection Using Convolutional Neural Networks at the 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Control Systems, where I explored the application of deep learning techniques for skin disease diagnosis. Building upon this, I further delved into optimizing convolutional neural networks through metaheuristic algorithms, as demonstrated in my subsequent publication in the book Emerging Technologies in Data Mining and Information Security. Continuing to push the boundaries, I recently co-authored a review paper on disease detection from medical images using machine learning, presented at the 2022 International Conference on Trends in Electronics and Informatics. My goal is to leverage the power of AI to enhance healthcare outcomes and contribute to the betterment of society.

name: Ms. Syeeda Shiraj-Um-Monira
faculty: Faculty of Health and Life Sciences
department: Department of Nutrition and Food Engineering
bio: Syeeda Shiraj-Um-Monira is a dedicated researcher specializing in Food Engineering and Technology. With a Master of Science from Bangladesh Agricultural University, her research focuses on food safety, preservation, and biotechnology. Notable contributions include studies on the impact of formaldehyde on fruit quality, published in reputable journals like the Journal of Bangladesh Agricultural University. Syeeda's expertise has been recognized through prestigious fellowships, including the National Science and Technology Fellowship and the Chinese Scholarship Council PhD fellowship. She has presented her findings at international conferences, showcasing her commitment to advancing scientific knowledge in food innovation and fermentation. With a strong foundation in food science and a passion for discovery, Syeeda is poised to continue making meaningful contributions to research, exemplifying dedication and excellence in her field.

name: Dr. Binoy Barman
faculty: Faculty of Humanities and Social Sciences
department: Department of English
bio: Professor Dr. Binoy Barman is an academician, researcher, translator and writer, residing in Dhaka, Bangladesh. He works as a Professor of English at Daffodil International University and also the Executive Editor of DIU Journal of Humanities and Social Sciences.  He used to be the Head of English Department and the Director of Daffodil Institute of Language (DIL). He did his MA in English and MPhil and PhD in Linguistics from the University of Dhaka. More than 20 research articles written by him have been published in reputed national and international journals, a few being Scopus-indexed. He has got more than 40 books to his credit. He took part in many seminars and conferences around the world, presenting papers and delivering keynote speeches, and also organized workshops, seminars and conferences in his institution. He is the recipient of UNICEF Meena Media Award and the Daily Star Celebrating Life Award, among others.

name: Dr. A.B.M. Kamal Pasha
faculty: Faculty of Health and Life Sciences
department: Department of Environmental Science and Disaster Management
bio: Dr. Pasha is the Professor of Environmental Science and Disaster Management at Daffodil International University, Dhaka, Bangladesh. He received his Ph.D. in Environmental Science from the Earth Science Division of Tohoku University, Sendai, Japan. His Ph.D. work covered the development of alluvial lowlands under different sea-level regimes along the Fukushima Coast, north-east Japan. Currently, he is the Chief Editor of the Journal of Environmental Issues and Climate Change. He was the principal investigator of an academic research project titled Unmanned Aerial System-based Assessment of Tree Cover and Deforestation Dynamics in Bangladesh. Through his scholarly work, he is contributing to academia and the scientific community by providing data and creating research-based, skilled young researchers, who are currently doing M.Sc. and Ph.D. with research in countries like USA, Canada, Luxemburg, South Korea, Japan, etc. Finally, he is a being who believes in contributing through sharing his information and knowledge with his students.

name: Dr. Mahfuza Parveen
faculty: Faculty of Health and Life Sciences
department: Department of Environmental Science and Disaster Management
bio: Dr. Mahfuza Parveen is currently working as Associate Professor and Research Coordinator in the Department of Environmental Science and Disaster Management, Daffodil International University, Bangladesh. She has completed her first Masters degree (M.S.) in Geological Sciences from Bangladesh and later earned Master of Engineering (M.Eng.) degree majoring in Environmental Sciences followed by a PhD degree from Saitama University, Japan. In the beginning of the career she is experienced working with a renowned environmental NGO in Bangladesh on climate change, environmental pollution, waste management and related environmental issues. Besides academic activities, she is now involved as Executive Board Member with the renowned environmental NGO of Bangladesh named “Environment and Social Development Organization-ESDO). She also gathered experience on waste management, environmental pollution and educational sectors while studying in Japan.

name: Dr. Sk. Abdul Kader Arafin

Alongside, I am deeply involved in advancing quality education initiatives and environmental conservation efforts. My interdisciplinary approach extends to material physics, where I explore the properties and interactions of materials. Through my work, I aim to contribute to a deeper understanding of radiation safety, environmental sustainability, quality education and public health. My research endeavors are driven by a commitment to addressing real-world challenges and promoting holistic solutions for the betterment of society.

name: Mr. Md. Ali Hossain
faculty: Faculty of Science and Information Technology
department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering
bio: Md. Ali Hossain is an Assistant Professor at Daffodil International University, Dhaka, Bangladesh, and a PhD fellow at the Department of Computer Science and Engineering, Jahangirnagar University. With over 12 years of teaching experience, he specializes in Computer Science and Engineering, particularly in bioinformatics, machine learning, and data science. His extensive research background spans 8 years in bioinformatics, contributing to advancements in computational biology. Md. Ali Hossain's dedication to both teaching and research underscores his commitment to excellence in the field of computer science and engineering.

name: Ms. Nafisa Farid Moumi
faculty: Faculty of Business and Entrepreneurship
department: Department of Real Estate
bio: A dynamic lecturer of the Department of Real Estate of Daffodil International University, blending a background in urban planning with a passion for sustainable urban development. With an undergraduate (Masters ongoing) degree in Urban Planning from BUET, my research interest encompasses land use and transportation planning, affordable housing, real estate, and environmental planning. Dedicated to bridging academia with practice, I am willing to engage in collaborative research endeavors and mentor students in developing analytical skills.

name: Mr. Md. Masud Alom
faculty: Faculty of Engineering
department: Department of Civil Engineering
bio: I am Md. Masud Alom working as an assistant professor at Civil Engineering Department, Daffodil International University. With my academic activities I am doing research specializing in environmental engineering, with a particular focus on water quality management and wastewater engineering. I have involved myself in various research projects aimed at improving water quality and advancing wastewater treatment technologies. My interests span a wide range of topics, including pollutant removal mechanisms, water quality monitoring, wastewater treatment processes optimization, and the development of sustainable water management strategies. I am trying to actively engaged myself in academic mentorship, supervising students, and participating in knowledge dissemination activities such as publishing research articles and presenting at conferences.

name: Professor Dr. Md. Fokhray Hossain
faculty: Faculty of Science and Information Technology
department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering
bio: Md. Fokhray Hossain is a Professor in the Department of Computer Science and Engineering (CSE) at Daffodil International University (DIU), Dhaka, Bangladesh. He has more than 31 years of teaching and research experience in Information System, Computer Architecture, Enterprise Networking, Telecommunication, Decision Support System, Management Information System, e-Commerce, e-business and so on. He had completed his PhD from University of Glamorgan, UK in 1998 through ODASSS scholarship. He also completed M.Sc. and B.Sc. (Hon) from the Department of Physics, Jahangirnagar University, Bangladesh in 1990 and 1989 respectively. He was appointed as a research fellow in Boss Center at Dhaka University from 1991 to 1993. He has more than 50 research publications in national & international journals and conferences. He has vast academic & research experiences in different countries including UK, Japan, S. Korea, Nepal, India, Malaysia, Sri Lanka, Philippines and Indonesia.

name: Mr. Sheikh Muhammad Rezwan
faculty: Faculty of Engineering
department: Department of Architecture
bio: Sheikh Md. Rezwan is an Architect and Academic. He is currently teaching at the Department of Architecture, DIU as an Assistant professor. He has completed his B.Arch and M.Arch degree from BUET. His master’s thesis titled ‘The Relationship between Children’s Physical Activity and Outdoor Design Features in Schools of Dhaka’. This is the first time in Bangladesh that children’s PA was objectively measured through Accelerometer. He served as a Research Assistant in two international projects. The first one, titled IPEN Adolescent Study, was funded by the National Institute of Health, USA (2016). The second one, titled Crisis-led approaches to teaching and learning in Bangladesh: New frameworks for blended learning in low-income countries, was a research between BUET and Cardiff University, UK (2021). He worked as the local team leader on a World Bank-funded Municipality project ‘Participatory Urban Design Consultancy’ in Dhaka. He is the founder of ‘Grammo’, a participatory rural residential research workshop program conducted each year since 2019.

faculty: Faculty of Health and Life Sciences
department: Department of Agricultural Science
bio: Dr. ATM Majharul Mannan is a researcher at Daffodil International University specializing in carrot and other vegetables crops specially in crop physiology and breeding. His works focuses on to improve the genetical materials specially for crop improvement, variety development etc. He is particularly interested in crop physiology, breeding and post-harvest of fruits and vegetables. Earlier he was affiliated with Bangladesh Agricultural university as an PhD fellow, collaborated researchers' of Bangladesh Agricultural research Institute  and Sher-e Bangla Agricultural University.

My work focuses on enhancing transparency in AI decisions using techniques like SHAP and LIME, Grad Cam, and Grad Cam++, particularly in healthcare and agriculture.  My goal is to develop models that not only excel in performance but also provide insights into their decision-making processes. I aim to bridge the gap between advanced technology and its practical applications, ensuring  trust in AI systems.

faculty: Faculty of Science and Information Technology
department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering
expertise: Internet of Things and Cyber Security
bio: I am Mohammad Jahangir Alam, serving as a Senior Lecturer at Daffodil International University in the field of Computer Science and Engineering. I attained both my B.Sc. and M.Sc. degrees in Computer Science and Engineering from Daffodil International University. Presently, I am pursuing my Ph.D. in Computer Science at Bangladesh University of Engineering and Technology (BUET). My research interests encompass Data Mining, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, the Internet of Things, and Cyber Security. I possess extensive expertise in software system development. For any inquiries, feel free to reach me via email at jahangir.csediu@gmail.com.

name: Professor Dr. Md. Abdur Rouf
faculty: Faculty of Business and Entrepreneurship
department: Department of Business Administration
expertise: Corporate Financial Reporting and Corporate Governance
bio: Professor Md. Abdur Rouf, Ph.D. born in 1978 in Nakua, Chandaikona, under Sherpur Upazila in Bogura District, is the son of Md. Tafir Uddin. His academic journey commenced with the completion of his S.S.C. from Chandaikona High School in 1994, followed by his H.S.C. from Govt. Azizul Haque College, Bogura in 1996. He obtained his Bachelor of Business Administration (B.B.A.) and Master of Business Administration (M.B.A.) degrees with a major in Accounting from the University of Rajshahi in 2001 and 2002, respectively. In 2016, he was awarded his Ph.D. in Firm-Specific Characteristics, Corporate Governance, and Voluntary Disclosure in Annual Reports of Listed Companies of Bangladesh from the Institute of Business Administration (IBA), University of Rajshahi, Bangladesh. Following a scholarship from the Indian Government, he pursued an IT-based training course titled OATM in New Delhi, India. Embarking on his academic career in 2007, he served several reputed institutions in Bangladesh. Presently, he holds the position of Professor of Accounting in the Department of Business Administration at Daffodil International University. For over eighteen years, he has actively engaged in instructing undergraduate and postgraduate programs. Prof. Rouf is enthusiastic about engaging in knowledge exchange and contributing his expertise in business domains, particularly in Accounting, Corporate Financial Reporting, Managerial Accounting, and Business Research Methodology. He welcomes opportunities to acquire new insights and expand his understanding through interactions with fellow professionals. Certified as a reviewer for Emerald, Elsevier, and Springer journals, his research interests span Corporate Financial Reporting and Corporate Governance, voluntary disclosure, corporate social responsibility reporting, systemic literature review (SLR), and environmental reporting. His 37 articles were published in national and international journals and conferences majority of which are Web of Science (WoS) and Scopus indexed.

name: Mr. Md. Rafiz Uddin

department: Department of English
bio: Md. Rafiz Uddin is a lecturer at the Department of English, Daffodil International University, Bangladesh. He received a bachelor’s degree in English in 2012 and a master’s degree in applied linguistics and ELT in 2013 from the University of Dhaka, Bangladesh. He has published a number of papers in preferred journals and participated in a range of national and international conferences, seminars, webinars and workshops on English language teaching and learning. He also presented various research-based papers at several national and international conferences. His areas of interest include curriculum and materials development, language pedagogy, second language acquisition (SLA), teacher education, and digital and online language learning.

name: Ms. Tasmia Tasnim
faculty: Faculty of Health and Life Sciences
department: Department of Nutrition and Food Engineering
bio: I am Tasmia Tasnim,  researching in the field of clinical nutrition, nutritional epidemiology, and diet quality. My research focuses on understanding the impact of nutrition on health outcomes, particularly in cardiovascular disease, chronic kidney disease, and maternal and child nutrition. Proficient in statistical software like SPSS, I employ advanced multivariate analyses to glean insights from complex datasets. With seven publications in esteemed QS journals, my work highlights the intricate relationship between diet and health. I am passionate about advancing public health through evidence-based interventions informed by rigorous research. With a keen focus on translating research findings into actionable solutions, I strive to bridge the gap between academia and real-world impact, ensuring that my work positively influences health policies and practices worldwide.

name: Dr. Mohammad Hannan Mahmud Khan
faculty: Faculty of Engineering
department: Department of Civil Engineering
bio: Dr. Mohammad Hannan Mahmud Khan is a distinguished researcher renowned for his expertise in transportation engineering and planning. His extensive research portfolio encompasses various facets of transportation engineering, including traffic planning, transportation system modeling, and forecasting. Dr. Khan's work not only sheds light on the complexities of modern traffic systems but also offers innovative solutions to enhance efficiency and sustainability. As a visionary in the field, Dr. Khan continues to spearhead groundbreaking research initiatives aimed at shaping the future of transportation. His relentless pursuit of excellence and dedication to advancing the field make him a leading figure in transportation engineering and planning.

name: Ms. Taqiyah Akhtar
faculty: Faculty of Health and Life Sciences
department: Department of Pharmacy
bio: Taqiyah Akhtar is a faculty member in the Department of Pharmacy at Daffodil International University and a former faculty member of World University of Bangladesh. She has a Bachelor of Pharmacy Professional degree from the Department of Pharmacy, University of Dhaka, and a Master of Pharmacy degree from the Department of Pharmaceutical Chemistry, University of Dhaka. She has research experience in the field of Medicinal Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Microbiology, Biochemistry and Molecular Biology, and Phytochemistry. She has three publications in two peer-reviewed journals as well as attended some national and international scientific conferences.

name: Dr. Fizar Ahmed
faculty: Faculty of Science and Information Technology
department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering
bio: Dr. Fizar Ahmed is an Associate Professor in the Department of Computer Science and Engineering at Daffodil International University, where he has been since 2019. He received his Ph.D. in Business Informatics from the Corvinus University of Budapest, Hungary in 2018.His research interests span both Machine Learning and Data Science. Specially in the area of Agriculture.  Much of his work has been on improving the understanding, design, and performance of Internet of Things (IoT), mainly through the application of data mining and Artificial Intelligent. In the IoT arena, he has worked on implementation of IoT in agriculture sector. He has explored the presence and implications of IoT in livestock and organic sector by using Government innovation fund. Under his supervision, about seventy students of undergraduate and postgraduate programs are conducting research, mostly on agriculture data analysis for climate resilient agriculture. He is playing a major role in industry and academic collaboration. Dr. Fizar is co-author of business informatics, predictive data analysis, Internet of things based papers and is the author of many papers in business and ICT journals and conferences. He is also the entrepreneur of ICT based smart agriculture and livestock farming for exploring the agro employment in the rural areas of Bangladesh. He is now the Director of Embedded System Research Laboratory of Daffodil International University.

He specializes in ELT, CLT, TESL/TEFL, equality in education, inclusive education, lifelong learning, curriculum design, literature, linguistics, SLA, STEM, etc.. His research interests include curriculum development, CLT, ELT, inequality education, equal opportunity, humanizing education, and critiquing world literature. With a wide range of experience in teaching language and literature for about five decades, Prof. Hoque has his vision of imparting knowledge and “contributing knowledge with ethical consideration”  as a holy duty to mankind.

His expertise encompasses a range of areas including food preservation, product development, and quality assurance. Monirujjaman is committed to applying his knowledge and skills to address challenges in the food industry, ultimately aiming to contribute to the development of sustainable and nutritious food products for the benefit of society.

bio: Mizanur Rahman is a distinguished Daffodil International University (DIU) faculty member recognized for expertise in Typography, Graphic Design, UI/UX Design, Advertising, Brand Design, and Packaging. bio: Dr. Mohammad Amjad Kamal is a visiting Professor at various Universities. He is leading a highly productive global collaborative research team based from Novel Global Community Educational Foundation (NGCEF), Australia. Dr. Kamal's biochemical research in the field of Alzheimer’s disease, Type 2 diabetes and leukemia etc. has culminated in more than 700 publications in internationally respected journals, and 65 abstracts at international conferences. Dr. Kamal migrated to Australia in 1998 and was awarded a prestigious U2000 Postdoctoral Fellowship in 2000 by the University of Sydney, School of Molecular and Microbial Biosciences. This three years highly competitive award funded his research on the Inhibition of amido phosphoribosyltransferase by new antifolates: Design and mechanism of action of purine antagonists. Amongst numerous projects, Dr. Kamal also collaborated on the molecular biological research project “Linkage of Alzheimer’s disease and Type 2 diabetes” at the University of Technology, Sydney - the commonalities underpinning these two disorders that impact a huge proportion of the world population remain an area of his current scientific focus. Moreover, he is serving as a regional/editorial member/guest editor of several reputed scientific journals - this is undertaken on an honorable basis.

name: Dr. S. M. Saiful Haque
faculty: Faculty of Humanities and Social Sciences
department: Department of Law
bio: Dr. S.M. Saiful Haque is a distinguished legal scholar and Associate Professor in the Department of Law, Faculty of Humanities and Social Sciences, at Daffodil International University, Bangladesh. A native of Feni, Bangladesh, Dr. Haque has over 15 years of experience as a faculty member, contributing to law, MBA, and other academic programs at various tertiary institutions across the country. Dr. Haque earned his Ph.D. in Law from TIU-WB, India, focusing on Street Child Criminality and Restorative Justice. His academic qualifications include an LL.B. (Hons.) and LL.M. in Law from the University of Chittagong, an MSS in Criminology and Criminal Justice from the University of Dhaka, and a two-year Master’s in Peace and Human Rights Development Studies (MPHRDS) from the Bangladesh University of Professionals. With a career marked by academic excellence and commitment to justice, he continues to inspire future legal minds. As an accomplished researcher, Dr. Haque has published over 14 scholarly articles in SCOPUS-indexed and other prestigious peer-reviewed national and international journals. He has supervised more than 100 legal research monographs and projects at the LL.M. and other graduate levels, with several notable works currently in progress. His broad areas of specialization include children’s rights, human rights, criminology, taxation law, family law, private law, maritime and shipping law, trade law, property law, intellectual property law, and patent law. Beyond his academic endeavours, Dr. Haque is an enrolled lawyer, a committed human rights activist, and a pioneer in advocacy for street children’s rehabilitation in Bangladesh. He has been actively involved in street lawyering since 2009 and has been a staunch proponent of non-violence, human rights, and peace. His work integrates rigorous legal theory with impactful, practical initiatives, cementing his reputation as a prominent figure in law and social justice. For more information on his academic contributions and ongoing projects, visit his profiles on Google Scholar, the Daffodil International University Faculty Page, and ORCID.

name: Dr. Md Nazmus Saqib
faculty: Faculty of Health and Life Sciences
department: Department of Nutrition and Food Engineering
bio: Dr. Md Nazmus Saqib is currently serving as Assistant Professor at the Department of Nutrition and Food Engineering at Daffodil International University. He embarked on his academic journey with a Bachelor's and Master's degree from Bangladesh Agricultural University in Food Engineering, followed by a PhD from the renowned Jiangnan University, which is globally recognized for its excellence in food science and engineering. Dr. Saqib's contributions during the COVID-19 pandemic earned him the Best Volunteer Award-2021, and his exceptional work during his doctoral studies was honored with the Research Scholar Award-2022. Additionally, he was a recipient of the National Science and Technology Fellowship during his master's studies. Before his tenure in academia, Dr. Saqib gained valuable industry experience by working in the Quality Assurance department at Mutual Food Products Ltd. (Horlicks). His expertise spans across food technology, food analysis, food safety, rheology, food design, food texture, food hydrocolloids, emulsions, and nano delivery systems. Dr. Saqib has a profound interest in traditional, indigenous, and future food technologies. Eager to foster collaborations, he looks forward to partnering with peers who share similar fields of interest or research objectives.

name: Mohammad Rokibul Kabir, PhD
faculty: Faculty of Business and Entrepreneurship
department: Department of Business Administration
bio: Professor Mohammad Rokibul Kabir is the Director of Human Resource Development Institute (HRDI) of Daffodil International University (DIU). He is also serving as the Head of the Department of Accounting of DIU. Dr. Kabir is an Adjunct Professor of Taylor’s University, Malaysia and Amity University, Mumbai. He is a Research Fellow of INTI International University, Malaysia. Professor Kabir is a distinguished academician and researcher with a diverse background spanning academia, industry, and legal practice. His leadership roles at Daffodil International University and affiliations with other academic institutions reflect his commitment to education and research. Dr. Kabir's extensive publication record and research interests demonstrate his expertise in accounting, business technology, education and finance. Additionally, his multidisciplinary approach, as evidenced by his post-doctoral research in blockchain use behavior and further studies in data analytics and design thinking, underscores his adaptability and forward-thinking mindset in addressing contemporary challenges in business and academia. Dr. Kabir has around sixty research publications in various peer-reviewed journals, covering topics such as accounting practices, business technology, education, and finance.

name: Dr. Md. Sarowar Hossain
faculty: Faculty of Health and Life Sciences
department: Department of Public Health
bio: Dr. Md. Sarowar Hossain is an Associate Professor in the Department of Pharmacy at Daffodil International University, Bangladesh. He holds a Ph.D. in Molecular Genetics from the University of Tsukuba, Japan, where his research focused on identifying genes responsible for obesity using forward genetic screening in mice. He was awarded “Young Investigator” Award in 2016 from the University of Tsukuba, Japan, for performing an excellent research work. Dr. Hossain's expertise lies in various areas of molecular genetics, cell biology, protein analysis, and gene transfer using vectors. He is also skilled in cell culture, animal models, and computer-aided drug design. Currently, his research interests in identifying natural compounds with different phytochemical and pharmacological properties from Bangladeshi plants. He is also working for designing drugs that target specific proteins using computational methods. Dr. Hossain has authored and co-authored several publications in scientific journals, demonstrating his commitment to research and development.

name: Md.Salman Sohel
faculty: Faculty of Humanities and Social Sciences
department: Department of Development Studies
bio: Md. Salman Sohel, a Lecturer and Research Coordinator at Daffodil International University, Bangladesh, holds a Master's degree in Public Management from Hohai University, China, and a Bachelor's degree in Social Science from Jagannath University, Bangladesh. His research spans environmental social governance (ESG), disaster and climate governance, and migration issues, with notable projects on women's leadership in e-business and climate change's impact on urban planning. He has authored numerous peer-reviewed articles and book chapters, presenting his findings internationally. Committed to community engagement, Md. Sohel has founded initiatives like the Daffodil International University Research and Higher Studies Society, demonstrating his dedication to societal development. Active in professional development, he engages in training workshops and serves as an associate editor and reviewer for academic journals, embodying his passion for advancing both academia and society.

name: Noor Muhammad
faculty: Faculty of Science and Information Technology
department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering
bio: Noor Muhammad, a passionate Mathematics Lecturer in the Department of Computer Science and Engineering, at Daffodil International University, holds an M.S. in Pure Mathematics from Pabna University of Science and Technology. His diverse research interests span Pure and Applied Mathematics, with a keen focus on Geometry, Computer Graphics, and Image Processing. With notable publications like Immeasurable soliton solutions and enhanced (𝐺′/𝐺)-expansion method in Physics Open, Noor showcases his commitment to advancing mathematical knowledge. His thesis on An Introduction to Space-Filling Curves and its Applications underscores his innovative approach to problem-solving. Noor is skilled in various programming languages (for instance, C/C++, Fortran 95, Python together with MATLAB, etc.) and proficient in English and Bengali. He has received prestigious scholarships and accolades, reflecting his academic excellence and commitment to Mathematics. Recently, his research has focused on Lie algebras and the application of Space-Filling Curves in Computer Graphics and Image Processing.

name: S. M. Mahmudur Rahman
faculty: Faculty of Health and Life Sciences
department: Department of Environmental Science and Disaster Management
bio: Currently, I want to treat the water with salinity and wastewater through different aquatic macrophytes with different concentrations of biochar. Because if we can find a solution for treating saline and waste water, we can help the coastal people ease their access to safe water. My research engages young minds, which creates opportunities for them to learn and get hands-on experience in research. Besides, I do work on identifying ecosystem services and assessing the plant diversity patterns of various environmental surroundings. The study findings and research experiences often support my teaching. It also creates opportunities for me to collaborate with other colleagues in a different field, helps me learn new things, and helps me understand the research more inclusively. Except for the feeling thrill of science and trying to get rid of the answers to these issues, I get my adrenaline from playing and watching different sport (especially cricket and football).

I am highly enthusiastic and motivated person towards new things which always push me towards new research and new findings. I am highly motivated towards the outcome base ethical research and projects. With my ethics, standards and devotion towards research and innovation i always try to inspire and motivate my students.

He holds a Master’s in Computer Science with a specialization in Data Science from Daffodil International University (2023) and a Bachelor’s in Computer Science and Engineering from the same institution (2019). Maruf’s expertise spans Educational Data Science, ICT-based Pedagogy, Mathematics Anxiety, Cybersecurity, and Machine Learning, making him a versatile and highly sought-after researcher. He was recognized with a prestigious Government Fellowship from the ICT Division, the People’s Republic of Bangladesh, for his outstanding MSc thesis. With 13+ Scopus-indexed journal publications to his name, Maruf is a significant contributor to the academic and research community. His dedication to advancing knowledge continues to lead to indelible contributions in the world of research and data science.

bio: Md. Monirul Islam is currently working as an Assistant Professor and Research coordinator in the Department of Software Engineering at Daffodil International University. Mr. Monirul published more than 28 articles in various prominent journals and conferences of Scopus indexed. He established a research lab named Rising Research Lab for undergraduate and graduate students to teach the research methodology. His research area is machine learning, IoT, and computational healthcare analytics.

name: Mr. Md. Shahriar Shakil
faculty: Faculty of Science and Information Technology
department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering
bio: Md. Shahriar Shakil is a dedicated educator and machine learning enthusiast, currently serving as a Lecturer in the Department of Computer Science and Engineering at Daffodil International University in Daffodil Smart City. Shakil's professional journey includes roles such as Teaching Assistant and Lecturer. Additionally, he has gained practical experience as an ML Trainee Programmer at Expert Consortium Ltd, Banasree, Dhaka. Shakil is proficient in programming languages like Python, Dart, C, Java, and JavaScript. He is adept in various machine learning frameworks and libraries, including TensorFlow, Keras, and Scikit-Learn. Shakil's research interests encompass machine learning, deep learning, computer vision, natural language processing, and data mining. He has published the results of his study in international peer-reviewed publications. Moreover, Shakil has contributed to the educational field by publishing several courses at the International Online University (IOU) related to Python. For further inquiries or collaboration opportunities, he can be contacted via email at shakil.cse@diu.edu.bd.

name: Dr. Salamat Khandker

bio: I am a medical doctor. Worked at the University Hospital Charlottenburg, Berlin. In 1988 pursued a Doctor of Medicine (PhD) from the Free University of Berlin and an M.Sc. CHDC in 1992/93 from the University of Heidelberg. Gathered 22 years of work experience in international development organizations, 18 years under WHO, and 4 years under UNDP. Conducted mixed-method community-based researches on arsenic contamination of groundwater and indoor air pollution. Have 35 research publications, and 11 years of teaching experience in Epidemiology, Occupational and Environmental Health, and Hospital Management. I have been providing programmatic leadership and strategic vision in the implementation of community programs under Nature Conservation Management (NACOM) and the implementation of improved cooking stoves (ICS) under the Directorate General of Environment (DOE). Since last two years providing technical support to the Line Director, NCD of the DGHS and Asian Arsenic Network, Bangladesh (AANB).

name: Mr. Syed Nazmus Sakib
faculty: Faculty of Health and Life Sciences
department: Department of Environmental Science and Disaster Management
bio: Syed Nazmus Sakib is an ambitious graduate student pursuing his additional M.Sc. degree at the Institute of Water and Flood Management, Bangladesh University of Engineering and Technology (BUET). Sakib is highly regarded for his ability to cultivate an inclusive and supportive classroom environment that fosters critical thinking and nurtures intellectual curiosity. Driven by a deep sense of dedication to humanity and the environment, Sakib aspires to become a distinguished Disaster Management Specialist and a prominent researcher in his field. By actively engaging in research and academia, he aims to fulfill his dream of imparting invaluable knowledge to others. Sakib has been honored with the prestigious National Science and Technology fellowship from the Ministry of Science and Technology, People's Republic of Bangladesh. He has also played an integral role in various research projects. His expertise spans GIS, Microsoft Office suite, Adobe suite, yED, and SPSS. Furthermore, he possesses skills in Hazard Identification & Risk Reduction, Program Management, Emergency Management, Quality Management, and Content Making. Successful at managing national interdisciplinary project and programming teams. a proven track record of over 7 years in providing design and implementation of different projects and research. name: Khondhaker Al Momin
faculty: Faculty of Engineering
