bio: Khondhaker Al Momin is currently working as a Senior Lecturer in the Department of Civil Engineering at Daffodil International University. He is also a Ph.D. candidate in the School of Civil Engineering & Environmental Science at the University of Oklahoma, Oklahoma, United States of America (USA). He has obtained his bachelor's and master's degrees in Civil Engineering from Bangladesh University of Engineering & Technology (BUET) and a Graduate Certificate in Data Science and Analytics from the University of Oklahoma, USA. Holding interdisciplinary qualifications in Civil Engineering, Systems Engineering, and Data Science, his research actively focuses on diverse areas, including traffic incident analysis and prevention, traffic flow theory, and ACES (autonomous, connected, electric, and shared) vehicles. His interests also extend to big data analytics, network science, natural hazards, and system optimization.

name: Mr. Aftab Hossain
faculty: Faculty of Humanities and Social Sciences
department: Department of Journalism, Media and Communication
bio: Aftab Hossain (pending PhD) is a leading figure in understanding the evolving landscape of social media and its impact on human behavior. As both an Assistant Professor and Head of the Department of Journalism, Media and Communication at Daffodil International University, Mr. Hossain is dedicated to both education and research. His recently submitted PhD thesis on cyberbullying on social media exemplifies his commitment to tackling pressing digital issues. His research goes beyond cyberbullying, encompassing the influence of social media on our perceptions (media framing), how news is delivered and analyzed, and the complex relationship between young people and the media they consume. His expertise spans social media, behavior change communication, media framing, news analysis, and youth and social sciences.

bio: Bimal Chandra Das received his bachelor of science with honors and masterof science degrees in applied mathematics from the University of Chittagong (CU),Bangladesh in 2000 and 2001 respectively. He received his Ph.D. degree in communicationengineering and informatics from the University of Electro-Communications (UEC), Tokyo,Japan in 2018. Currently, he is working as an Associate Professor at Daffodil InternationalUniversity (DIU), Dhaka, Bangladesh. He joined Daffodil International University in 2008 asa Lecturer. He received the Japan Government (Monbukagakusho: Mext)Scholarship 2014 for a Ph.D. degree. Recently, he completed a post-doctoral research fellowproject work at UEC, Japan. He presented many research papers in Japan, Canada, and theUnited States. during his Ph.D. research. His research interest includes computer network,network congestion, power-efficient networks, continuous optimization, and conicprogramming and its applications. He published many research papers and books in theworld’s reputed journals and conferences.

(Engg.) degree in Information and Communication Technology (ICT) from Mawlana Bhashani Science and Technology University. He has authored more than ten research articles and two book chapters published in reputable journals by esteemed publishers.

name: Md Mizanur Rahman
faculty: Faculty of Health and Life Sciences
department: Department of Pharmacy
bio: Mr. Md. Mizanur Rahman, a dedicated Assistant Professor, devotes his knowledge to pharmaceutical research. His scholastic endeavors cover a wide range of essential topics in pharmaceutical sciences, including pharmacological research and technological developments. Rahman researches novel drug formulations and their efficacy in preclinical settings, with the goal of enhancing therapeutic outcomes. Rahman's research interests extend outside the laboratory to include the study of pharmaceutical marketing practices and the impact of healthcare policy on medicine access and affordability. Rahman intends to provide beneficial insights to the pharmaceutical industry by doing rigorous research that promotes innovation and evidence-based practice. His impressive publication record of 32 publications, including those in top Q3-ranked journals, displays his research expertise.  Rahman has made significant contributions to medical research. His active participation in professional associations, as well as his continual training, demonstrate his commitment to expanding scientific knowledge and fostering high-quality pharmaceutical studies.

name: Md. A.K. Azad
faculty: Faculty of Health and Life Sciences
department: Department of Pharmacy
bio: Mr. Md. A.K. Azad, a passionate assistant professor, explores the vast potential of therapeutics within the pharmaceutical and biological sciences. His research interests span a diverse spectrum, encompassing phytopharmacology (harnessing the therapeutic power of plant-derived compounds), neuropharmacology (examining drugs and their impact on the nervous system), cardiovascular pharmacology (investigating drugs' effects on the heart and circulatory system), and gastrointestinal and hepatic studies (delving into the digestive and liver functions). This multifaceted approach allows him to explore how plant-based bioactives interact with various physiological systems. He strives to understand these mechanisms to develop potential therapies for neurological, cardiovascular, and gastrointestinal/hepatic diseases. Mr. Azad further commands computer-aided drug design to expedite this process. His impressive publication record of 50 articles, including those in prestigious Q1-ranked journals, underscores his research excellence. Moreover, his expertise in conducting in vivo studies and analysing biostatistical data empowers him to translate research findings into practical applications.

name: Dr. Nizam Uddin
faculty: Faculty of Health and Life Sciences
department: Department of Nutrition and Food Engineering
bio: Currently, I am serving as an Associate Professor and Head, the Department of Nutrition and Food Engineering, Faculty of Health and Life Sciences, Daffodil International University, Dhaka, Bangladesh since January 2020. I finished my B.Sc. (Honours) and M.Sc. (Thesis) in Applied Chemistry & Chemical Engineering from the University of Dhaka, Bangladesh. I completed a Ph.D. in Life Science from the College of Natural Sciences, Kyungpook National University, South Korea in June 2015. I worked as a postdoctoral research fellow in Hannam University, South Korea from September 2015 to December 2017. In January 2018, I was appointed as a Research Assistant Professor College of Natural Sciences, Kyungpook National University, South Korea. I was serving as Adjunct Faculty of the Institute of Leather Engineering & Technology, Faculty of Science, University of Dhaka, Bangladesh. My current research interests is Heavy Metal Pollution, Public Health, Global Health, Food Adulteration, Food Toxicology, Human Nutrition, Environmental Pollution, Water Pollution, Atomic Absorption Spectroscopy, Thermodynamics, and Molecular Dynamics Simulation.

name: Prof. Dr. Md. Ekramul Haque
faculty: Faculty of Health and Life Sciences
department: Department of Pharmacy
expertise: Structure elucidation of new natural compounds
bio: Prof. Dr. Mdf. Ekramul Haque is a researcher specialising in the chemistry of bioactive natural products. Their expertise lies in isolating bioactive compounds from natural sources using bioactivity-guided isolation techniques. This involves purifying the isolated compounds and elucidating their structures using various spectroscopic methods like IR, UV, Mass Spec, NMR, and X-ray crystallography. Prof. Ekramul has extensive experience in evaluating research projects and theses related to natural product chemistry. Their work includes reviewing M.Pharm., M.Sc., M.Phil., Ph.D., and Post Doc theses from universities across Bangladesh, India, Pakistan, Japan and England. Their research interests are exemplified by their publications on the chemical investigation of Euphorbia helioscopia seed oil and the regioselective modification of carbohydrates using tin compounds. He has a good number of publications in different renowned journals.

name: Md. Asaduzzaman Naeem

With a foundation in  Civil Engineering, I have honed my skills in both lab based and software analysis. My journey in academia has been marked by a commitment to rigorous inquiry and a thirst for discovery, which has led to analyze the effect of fire in beam column joint. Whether conducting experiments in the laboratory, analyzing data sets, or collaborating with fellow researchers, I thrive on the challenges inherent in pushing the boundaries of what is known. With a keen eye for detail and a creative approach to problem-solving, I am driven by the belief that research is not just a profession but a calling—a quest for understanding that holds the promise of shaping a better future for generations to come.

name: Prof. Dr. A.K.M. Fazlul Haque
faculty: Faculty of Engineering
department: Department of Information and Communication Engineering
bio: Prof. Dr. A.K.M. Fazlul Haque, is a renowned scholar and researcher specializing in Electronics, Telecommunication Engineering, and Computer Science. With a Ph.D. from Jahangirnagar University and an M.Sc. from the University of Applied Sciences, Darmstadt, Germany, he brings extensive international experience. Currently, he serves as the Director of Institutional Quality Assurance Cell (IQAC) and a Professor at Daffodil International University. Dr. Haque's research spans Telemedicine, Signal Processing, Computer Networking, and Data Communication, reflected in his 100+ journal and conference papers. He's an active member of prestigious professional societies, including IEEE and Bangladesh Computer Society. Recognized for his mentorship, he has supervised numerous theses and received accolades like the IEEE CS Bangladesh Academic and Research Excellence Award. Prof Haque advocates for diversity in academia and contributes significantly to quality assurance and innovation initiatives. His expertise, coupled with a commitment to inclusivity, establishes him as a distinguished figure in academia. .  Prof. Haque has been recognized for his outstanding contributions to the field of education and research with the 'Most Outstanding Professor' award from the world education congress.

name: Shirin Sultana
faculty: Faculty of Science and Information Technology
department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering
bio: As a researcher in inventory management with a focus on sustainability, I am committed to minimizing carbon emissions throughout the supply chain. My work revolves around developing innovative strategies that not only optimize inventory control and reduce costs but also mitigate environmental impact. By integrating carbon emission considerations into inventory models and logistics optimization algorithms, I strive to identify opportunities for reducing transportation distances, optimizing storage facilities, and promoting eco-friendly sourcing practices. Through rigorous analysis and data-driven methodologies, I aim to uncover actionable insights that enable businesses to achieve their inventory management goals while minimizing their carbon footprint. By bridging the gap between environmental responsibility and operational efficiency, I am dedicated to advancing sustainable inventory management practices that contribute to a greener future for businesses and communities alike.

name: Aklima Akter

She does research on different formulations, phytoconstituents, and comparative studies among different solvent plant extracts. Recently, her research direction is cognitive neuroscience and neuroimaging, including cognitive neural mechanism of human reasoning. She would like to contribute to research that has the potential to have a big impact on the world.

name: Md.Riaduzzaman
faculty: Faculty of Humanities and Social Sciences
department: Department of Law
bio: Md. Riaduzzaman is an Assistant Professor, Department of Law at Daffodil International University. He has obtained his LLB (Hons.) and LLM from University of Dhaka. He also obtained LLB (Hons.) from University of London. He has more than 12 years of experiences in teaching. During his stay in the department, he led and actively participated in the development of teaching materials and curriculums (both LLB and LLM). He is the founding director of Daffodil Legal Research Center (DLRC). Md.Riaduzzaman’s previous experience and current research interest covers the area of human rights and digital constitutionalism. He has published several articles in national and international jornals. His PhD research focuses the comparative constitutional law methods in the context of Bangladesh.

name: Farhana Yeasmin Lina
faculty: Faculty of Business and Entrepreneurship
department: Department of Tourism and Hospitality Management
expertise: Potential impacts of tourism in Bangladesh
bio: Farhana Yeasmin Lina is a dedicated Lecturer in the Department of Tourism & Hospitality Management within the Faculty of Business & Entrepreneurship at Daffodil International University. Currently pursuing an MPhil degree at the University of Dhaka in the same department, Lina holds both a BBA and an MBA from the University of Dhaka, specializing in Tourism and Hospitality Management. With a teaching tenure since 2021, Lina's expertise spans various courses in the field. Her research focal points encompass Community-based tourism development (CBT), examining the potential impacts of tourism in Bangladesh, gauging tourist perceptions and satisfaction, and exploring the role of smart technologies in advancing the tourism and hospitality industry. Committed to academic and professional growth, Lina is dedicated to contributing meaningful insights and knowledge to the field.

name: Abu Saeid

bio: Mr. Abu Saeid, hailing from Rangpur, Bangladesh, has been a Lecturer (Senior Scale) in the Department of Nutrition and Food Engineering at Daffodil International University since October 2023. He is pursuing a PhD in Food Science at the Memorial University of Newfoundland, St. John's, Canada, since May 17, 2024. He obtained a Bachelor of Science in Food and Process Engineering (2014) and a Master of Science in Food Processing and Preservation (2016) from Hajee Mohammad Danesh Science and Technology University, Bangladesh. His prior roles included a stint as a Research Assistant at Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujibur Rahman Agricultural University and a lecturer at NPI University of Bangladesh. With 18 journal articles and five book chapters published in peer-reviewed national and international reputed journals, his research spans natural food colors, enzymes, new product development, and sea cucumber polysaccharides. Mr. Saeid aims to further his expertise and contribute significantly to academia and research.

bio: Afsana Jerin Shayery is a lecturer of English at Daffodil International University. With a Master’s degree specializing in English Language Teaching (ELT), she brings expertise to her role as a new academician. Afsana's passion lies in the field of language teaching methodologies, second language acquisition, outcome-based education, English for specific purposes, and quality education. Prior to her teaching career, she served as a teaching apprentice fellow, honing her skills and gaining valuable experience in the classroom. Before that, she worked in the international affairs office, where she developed a deep understanding of global issues and intercultural communication. During her academic journey, Afsana actively participated in international leadership development programs, where she cultivated leadership skills and a global perspective. Notably, she took part in pitching competitions focused on Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), showcasing her commitment to making a positive impact on society through education and advocacy.

name: Mr. Mushfiqur Rahman
faculty: Faculty of Science and Information Technology
department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering
bio: Mushfiqur Rahman is a senior faculty member in the Department of CSE at Daffodil International University. He is a research enthusiast interested in artificial intelligence, machine learning, Deep learning and Computer Vision. He has contributed to many fruitful research articles as an author or co-author. He has experience in research and software application development.

name: Khalid Md. Bahauddin
faculty: Faculty of Graduate Studies
department: Faculty of Graduate Studies
bio: As an interdisciplinary environmental educator, researcher, and professional, I have been deeply involved in education and research since 2009, with a focus on environmental and developmental issues. My expertise spans approximately 10 years, during which I have successfully managed and contributed to various projects funded by prominent organizations like the Government of Bangladesh, the European Union, UNDP, Oxfam, and others. I have been recognized internationally by institutions like MIT and UNESCO for my contributions to environmental research. In my academic role, I have supervised numerous bachelor’s and master’s students across diverse interdisciplinary areas. My research proficiency includes both qualitative and quantitative methods, grant writing, and research dissemination, underscored by 30 research publications and five book chapters. My affiliations with various national and international societies further my commitment to sustainable development.

name: Mr. Md. Mazbaur Rashid
faculty: Faculty of Science and Information Technology
department: Department of Software Engineering
bio: I am Md. Mazbaur Rashid, Lecturer, Department of Software Engineering. My passion lies in exploring the vast potential of Artificial Intelligence (AI). My research journey through Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Image Processing, and Computer Vision allows me to explore how these technologies can be used to solve real-world problems. I'm particularly interested in exploring how AI can be used to identify and analyze objects within images and videos, with a keen interest in its potential for disease diagnosis and improvement of healthcare outcomes.

name: Ms. Khairun Nahar
faculty: Faculty of Humanities and Social Sciences
department: Department of English
bio: I am Khairun Nahar. Currently appointed as Lecturer in the Department of English at Daffodil International University. I completed my graduation and post graduation from Department of English, Jahangirnagar University. As a published author, I am concentrating my research work on Creative writing and English Studies.

name: Mr. Md. Imran Hasan Bappy
faculty: Faculty of Engineering
department: Department of Civil Engineering
bio: I have been working as Lecturer of Civil Engineering Department in Daffodil International University. I am continuing my M.Sc. Engg. in Water Resources Engineering at Bangladesh University of Engineering & Technology (BUET). I have completed my graduation in Civil Engineering from Khulna University of Engineering and Technology (KUET) in 2020. I have published a research article in a scopus indexed journal and another one in an indexed International conference. I have worked as a co supervisor of a M.Sc. Engg. student and surpervised 32 B.Sc. Engg. students. My research is going on construction materials and the impact of climate change.

name: Samiha Khan
faculty: Faculty of Humanities and Social Sciences
department: Department of Development Studies
bio: I am a Lecturer in Development Studies at the Faculty of Humanities and Social Sciences, Daffodil International University (DIU), in Bangladesh. My research focuses on climate governance, particularly how marginalized communities engage with global climate policies. My academic journey includes conducting vulnerability assessments in rural Bangladesh and contributing to policy frameworks on climate resilience and gender equality. I have published research on climate adaptation and supported fieldwork for policymakers transitioning from COP26 to COP27. In addition to teaching, I have led initiatives to create inclusive academic environments, such as redesigning curricula to address systemic barriers faced by students.

name: Dr. Md. Shahin Azad
faculty: Faculty of Engineering
department: Department of Electrical and Electronic Engineering
bio: Dr. Md. Shahin Azad is an Assistant Professor in Chemistry at Electrical and Electronic Engineering Department of Daffodil International University. I have successfully completed a Ph.D degree in Chemistry from Universiti Sains Islam Malaysia (USIM). I have completed B. Sc (hon’s), and M. Sc in Chemistry. I have also completed M. Phil in Organic Chemistry from Bangladesh University of Engineering and Technology (BUET). Already I have successfully participated in four International Conferences as a presenter. I have published four research articles in different International Journal with Scopus Index. I have one year experience as a ‘Teaching Assistant’ in the department of Chemistry at BUET where I helped to conduct Chemistry lab courses. I have also experienced as a Lecturer (part-time) in Chemistry in the EEE department at Daffodil International University (DIU). I have also experienced about 10 years’ as a Lab Instructor or Technical officer, Sr. Technical officer and Assistant Director in the Chemistry lab under Faculty of Engineering at DIU. I am expert in hetero cyclic organic compound synthesis and purification of wastewater by using activated carbon produced from natural by-products such as Rice husk, Coconut coir, Corn cobs, Neem husk and Moringa oleifera etc.
